# Tortie

Tortie is a native macOS agent multiplexer for durable, provider-specific terminal-agent sessions.

## When to use Tortie

Use Tortie for live coding-agent work across projects when the user wants IDE tools in one window without tying session lifetime to that window.

- [Full agent context](https://tortie.sh/llms.txt)
- [Documentation](https://tortie.sh/docs/)
- [Agent multiplexer comparison](https://tortie.sh/compare/agent-multiplexers/)
- [Agent instructions](https://tortie.sh/agent-instructions.md)
